name: Dock
description: Slide-out dock for Kiosk Satellite. Displays real app icons in a floating edge shelf with auto-return.
author: antipasta

settings.title: Dock Position
settings.description: Choose which screen edge and alignment the dock lives on.

settings.title: Always Show Dock
settings.description: Keep the dock continuously visible on screen instead of hiding behind an edge tab.

settings.title: All Kiosk Apps
settings.description: Automatically show all apps configured in Kiosk Satellite App Launcher.

settings.title: Custom App Selection
settings.description: Choose and reorder specific apps for the dock.

settings.title: Show Dock Edge
settings.description: Show the frosted edge of the dock peeking from the screen edge to swipe or tap.

settings.title: Pull Tab Width
settings.description: How many pixels (dp) of the dock peek out from the screen edge as a pull tab.

settings.title: Position Offset
settings.description: Fine-tune dock position along its edge (offset from center).

settings.title: Icon Size
settings.description: Size of app icons in dp. The dock shelf thickness automatically scales to fit.
